projects.title: Forsaken Hospital Prototype
projects.shortDescription: Modular C# gameplay framework for First-Person Survival Horror in Unity with procedural weapons, interactions, and custom Editor tools.
projects.fullDescription: A modular C# gameplay framework for First-Person Survival Horror games in Unity, featuring procedural weapons, interactions, flashlight battery mechanics, physical item examination, and custom Editor tools. Engineered with clean decoupled events and zero-allocation raycasting for stutter-free performance.
features: Procedural first-person weapon sway, sprint bobbing, and aim smoothing
Physical item inspection system with rotational 3D examination
Flashlight power consumption with flicker states and battery mechanics
Interactive door and drawer physics with analog mouse drag manipulation
Modular inventory grid with sound propagation and event dispatchers
highlights: Modular architecture enabling rapid horror game mechanics authoring
Zero-allocation raycasting and event delegates avoiding GC stutter
Custom Unity Editor tools for rapid level designer workflow

projects.title: Dark House
projects.shortDescription: Atmospheric psychological survival horror prototype with dynamic lighting, spatial audio, and stealth AI mechanics.
projects.fullDescription: An atmospheric survival horror  hide and seek exploration experience built with Unity ‌Built in . Features dynamic ray-traced shadows, interactive puzzle locks,  and reactive enemy AI driven by behavior trees and acoustic stimulus detection.
features: Dynamic room-to-room occlusion culling and atmospheric volumetric fog
Auditory detection system where player footsteps and noises trigger enemy investigations
Modular lockpicking and mechanical puzzle solver with tactile interaction
Cinematic camera transitions and adaptive ambient soundscapes
highlights: Bespoke horror sound design paired with 3D audio spatialization
Highly responsive first-person character controller with physical collision
Optimized post-processing stack maintaining steady 60+ FPS
